%description: Curated sets for parsing a vehicle gun's blended item_type / class_name into two facets. Hand-curated like classifications.json; the API's generated labels are not trusted. damageTypes match the class_name type segment (prefix, space-stripped) or the label's leading token. mechanisms match a token/substring of the player-facing label (firing authority); aliases fix the 'Canon' typo (ScatterGun is already handled by case-folding). Keep damageTypes free of entries that prefix another (e.g. avoid adding 'Mass' alongside 'Mass Driver'), since damage matching is a leading-prefix match.
